meta.title: BiliTools · Bilibili downloader for Android
meta.description: BiliTools is a free, open-source Bilibili parser and downloader for Android. Save videos, anime, music and articles, pick your quality, and export subtitles and danmaku. Available in 13 languages.
meta.ogDescription: Start with a link and keep the videos, anime, music and articles you love. Free, open source, made for Android.

features.title: From one link to a complete collection.
features.description: Parse, pick, download and organize, all in one app.

share.title: Share to parse
share.description: Choose Share → BiliTools in Bilibili or any other app, then parse and download right in the pop-up panel without switching apps. You can also paste a link or type an ID.

quality.title: Top-tier quality
quality.description: Up to 8K, Dolby Vision and HDR, plus Hi-Res lossless and Dolby Atmos audio, with AVC, HEVC and AV1 codecs to choose from.
quality.note: Available quality depends on the content and your account.

export.title: Export everything
export.description: Subtitles, AI summaries, current and historical danmaku, NFO metadata, covers and posters. Articles are saved as Markdown, and tags and covers can be written into audio and video files.

batch.title: Batch downloads, kept tidy
batch.description: Select episodes, collections, favorites and playlists in one go. Downloads are grouped by title with live progress, and naming templates keep your files organized.

languages.title: 13 interface languages
languages.description: Every language is built in and switches instantly. Arabic uses a right-to-left layout.

privacy.title: Your data stays on your device
privacy.description: Login credentials, settings and download records are stored only on your device. Diagnostic reports are never uploaded automatically; you preview them and decide whether to share. BiliTools is free and open source.

login.question: Do I need a Bilibili account?
login.answer: No. You can parse and download without logging in. Logging in unlocks the higher video and audio quality available to your account, and historical danmaku also requires login. You can log in with a QR code, a password or an SMS code.

package.question: Which package should I download?
package.answer: arm64-v8a suits most phones and tablets. If you're not sure about your device, choose the universal package, which includes all four architectures and is larger. Every package has the same features.

location.question: Where are downloaded files saved?
location.answer: In the Download/BiliTools folder on your phone by default. You can choose another subfolder under Download in Settings → Download, and customize folder and file names in Settings → Naming.

quality.question: Why can't I select some quality options?
quality.answer: Available video quality, audio quality and extras depend on what the video or audio offers and on your account's permissions. Logging in unlocks the higher quality available to your account.

update.question: How do I update to a new version?
update.answer: Open Settings → About → Check for updates. The app downloads the right package for your device, with mirror support for faster downloads. You can also come back to this page anytime.

privacy.question: Is my data uploaded anywhere?
privacy.answer: No. Login credentials, settings and download records are stored only on your device, and the app offers no cloud sync. Diagnostic reports are created on your device with credentials, IP addresses and your account UID removed, and you decide whether to share them after previewing.
